description: Turn timed words + a look (+ optional overrides/settings) into validated props { doc, style, settings } for the CaptionedVideo Remotion composition (import { CaptionedVideo } from "captionseasy/remotion"; render it in your own timeline, mode "burn" over a video or "overlay" for captions only). Pure and instant: no video, no rendering. Pass `words` inline or `words_file` (a JSON file with an array or { words }). Pass `out` to write the props to a file and get a short summary back instead of the full JSON. Invalid keys/values return a clear error listing what is allowed.

language.description: Language tag stored in the doc (default "en")

look.description: Look number (e.g. 12) or id (e.g. "hormozi_box"), from list_looks

out.description: Optional path to write the props JSON

overrides.description: Style changes, keys from describe_look controls (flat dot paths), e.g. {"active.color": "#FF3366", "fontSize": 80, "position.y": 0.8}

settings.description: Pacing changes, keys from describe_look settings, e.g. {"maxWordsPerCard": 2}

words.description: Timed words, milliseconds on the video's clock

name: build_captions
title: Build caption props
